alibabacloud-dlf-manage 0.0.1 — Initial release

- Provides read-only querying of Catalog, database, and table metadata in Alibaba Cloud Data Lake Formation (DLF) using the Python SDK.
- Supports listing and searching Catalogs, databases, and tables, and viewing detailed information including Schemas.
- All operations are executed through the provided Python script `scripts/dlf_metadata_query.py`, not via shell commands or direct API calls.
- Enforces security by using the default Alibaba Cloud credential chain and never exposing credentials.
- Only lightweight list actions are used by default; detailed queries are executed only when explicitly requested.
- Includes clear instructions for permissions, authentication, and required parameters.
